items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: But you know, the early Coltrane was the best. ... But then when he went into this other Coltrane, (inaudible) what I call the exercise thing where he do all the notes and stuff like that, and way out stuff and eccentric stuff, his fans bought it.

ctx.x: But if he came along in the 1940's --
But you know, the early Coltrane was the best. The early Miles Davis was the best.
